title: action_taxonomy.jsonl (Hugging Face release -- facet-level tutor-action classifications)
description: One row per decomposed tutor action (facet): every item of `action_decomposed` for the scaffolding moments of the human tutors (`ground_truth`) and of the paper's AI-tutor replays (`benchmark_520`: 7 models x 2 prompts). Kept facets carry a model-generated category from the 13-letter A-M action taxonomy (scheme lm_extended_v1); facets removed by the pre-classification filter carry category null and an excluded_reason. Distributions are computed over kept facets only (macro mean over moments).
$comment: Regenerated classifications, not the paper's pools: they do not reproduce the paper's Fig 4 or KL-divergence table exactly (the paper's canonical numbers are v1_action_taxonomy_distribution.csv and kl_divergence_table.tex in the code repo). The companion action_taxonomy.manifest.json records the input dataset revision and file hashes, the classifier model/config and prompt hash, counts, token usage, and this file's hashes. Rows are sorted by (source, tutor_model, prompt_mode, moment_id, key_moment_index, statement_index), which is unique.

source.description: `human`: a human tutor's moment from ground_truth. `benchmark_520`: an AI tutor's replay from benchmark_520.

tutor_model.description: AI tutor model id (benchmark_520.tutor_model); null for human rows.

prompt_mode.description: AI tutor prompt (benchmark_520.prompt_mode); null for human rows.

moment_id.description: Human: `{conversation_id}__{turn_start}_{turn_end}__{annotator_id}` -- each annotator's pass is its own moment; a few ground_truth key-moment records share an id and are pooled as one moment. benchmark_520: moments.id, i.e. `balanced_520:{scenario_id}`, unique within a (tutor_model, prompt_mode) cell.

key_moment_index.description: Human: index of the source record in the ground_truth row's `key_moments` list. Null for benchmark_520 rows.

transcript_id.description: Source transcript id (ground_truth.conversation_id; for benchmark_520, the trailing UUID of conv_id).

turn_start.description: First turn of the annotated span.

turn_end.description: Last turn of the annotated span.

statement_index.description: Position of the statement in the source `action_decomposed` list.

statement.description: The `action_decomposed` item: one sentence of an LLM decomposition of the free-text `action` description (the human annotator's for human rows, the scoring pipeline's for benchmark_520 rows).

situation_label.description: The moment's gold situation. Human: ground_truth `situation_label_agg` (scaffolding | rigor | mixed | neither | both | unknown). benchmark_520: moments.dimension (scaffolding | rigor).

action_label.description: Overall direction of the tutor's action for the moment (scaffolding | rigor | both | neither | unknown). Human: ground_truth `action_direction_agg`; benchmark_520: annotation `action_label`.

result_label.description: Student outcome for the moment (pos | neg | no_evidence). Human: ground_truth `student_outcome_agg`; benchmark_520: annotation `result_label`.

stance_prefixed.description: The statement contains a stance phrase (e.g. `scaffolds`, `pushes for rigor`). Audit flag set by the filter.

category.description: Model-assigned action category (A-M); null for excluded facets.

enum: Prompting for explanation, justification, or reasoning
Transitioning to a new problem or topic

orientation.description: Orientation of `category` (A-F scaffolding, G-J rigor, K-M neutral).

excluded_reason.description: Why the pre-classification filter removed the facet, or null if kept. non_tutor_actor: the subject is not `the tutor` (e.g. `The student correctly identifies 3/8.`, `There is no scaffolding.`). pure_stance: a stance with no concrete move (`The tutor is scaffolding throughout.`). stance_negation: a negated stance (`The tutor does not push for rigor.`). non_action: something the tutor did not do (`The tutor does not increase complexity.`).
